title: Phases of matrix-product states with symmetries and measurements: Finite nilpotent groups
summary: We study phases of one-dimensional matrix-product states (MPS) when transformations are restricted to symmetric local circuits supplemented with symmetric measurements and feedforward (G-CMF). Building on the framework introduced in Gunn et al., Phys. Rev. B 111, 115110 (2025), we extend the analysis to all finite nilpotent groups for which we obtain a complete classification of G-CMF phases. We construct explicit symmetry-respecting protocols that map any symmetry-protected topological (SPT) or non-normal (GHZ-type) MPS to the trivial phase-and vice versa-with success probability…
